title: Casement uPVC Doors
whatIsIt: A side-hinged door for interior and exterior openings, including balcony doors, built for weatherproofing and dust resistance.
whyChooseIt: The most weather-tight door style, with international hardware compatibility and a firm wall attachment that resists deflection over time.

benefits.title: Weatherproof & dust-resistant
benefits.description: Sealed construction keeps out dust and driving rain.

benefits.title: Sturdy, durable build
benefits.description: Firm wall attachment prevents deflection under regular use.

benefits.title: Acoustic & thermal upgrade
benefits.description: Optional threshold available for enhanced sound and heat insulation.

designOptions: Compatible with toughened or laminated glass; maximum width of 1200mm per leaf.
